''See also: [[Talos Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-02-crimson-vault|Talos, also known as Heir Talos, is the firstborn son of [[King Zakareth the Sixth|Zakareth the Sixth]] and the last remaining legitimate successor to the [[Damascan]] throne. Physically, he is a tall, powerful individual with blond hair and striking features that project an air of commanding self-assurance. While he carries the appearance of a traditional royal, he prefers the title of Heir over prince. His personality is characterized by a smug confidence and an eager, almost unstable intensity that suggests an underlying madness. Talos is a dangerous political figure who has formed secret alliances with Overlords, including [[Lysander Torannus|Lysander]], to further his own ambitions. Rather than prioritizing the welfare of the [[Damascan]] people, he is focused on his own desires and has plotted to assassinate the King during wartime. His ultimate goal involves working with [[Lysander Torannus|Lysander]] to rule the world, even if it means preventing the recovery of [[The Tree|the Tree]]. In confrontations, he is known to offer terms of alliance or combat, though he has also faced significant physical injury, including the loss of an eye.}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-02-crimson-vault|Talos possesses curly golden hair and is dressed in a black and red suit. At one point, his body was found on blue tiles with a livid red mark around his neck.}}

== Personality ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-02-crimson-vault|He acts as a proud older brother to [[Leah]]. As the [[Damascan]] royal heir, he has spent years planning against [[King Zakareth VI|King Zakareth]] alongside [[Lysander Torannus|Lysander]].}}

== Relationships ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-02-crimson-vault|Talos is the son of [[King Zakareth VI|King Zakareth]] and acts as a proud older brother to [[Leah]]. He has spent years conspiring against his father alongside [[Lysander Torannus|Lysander]], and he may eventually collaborate with [[Alin]] for an assault on [[Cana]].}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-02-crimson-vault|As a [[Traveler of Ragnarus]], he has the power to travel back to [[Cana]]. He wields a crimson blade that is an artifact of [[Ragnarus the Crimson Vault|Ragnarus]], and he also uses a jeweled staff to deflect attacks.}}

== The Crimson Vault ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-02-crimson-vault|As the curly-haired firstborn son of [[King Zakareth the Sixth]], Talos is a [[Damascan]] royal heir and lord who carries an artifact sword with a red blade. Acting as a proud older brother to [[Leah]], he spent years planning an assassination against his father alongside [[Lysander Torannus|Lysander]]. During the war preparations, the unit leader and [[Ragnarus Traveler]] betrayed [[Zakareth]] by bringing a strike force from [[Enosh]] to lead a battle. After commanding the eruption of combat, Talos was located in the [[Damascan camp]] waiting for the [[Grandmasters]]. He used a jeweled staff to deflect his father's spear, but he was eventually found lying on blue tiles with a livid red mark around his neck.}}
